correctness.rationale: All M softmax logits g_m in R^(p+1) can be shifted by the same u with exp(x~^T u) cancelling from every numerator and denominator, so unconstrained likelihood is exactly constant along p+1 dimensions and not identifiable merely up to label switching. Conversely full affine rank and equality of all gate functions identifies log-odds (g_m-g_M)^T x~, making the common shift the only representation gauge. Fix g_M=0 to remove it. BIC counts 3,8,13,18 for M=1..4 match component counts 3M plus 2(M-1) rather than unconstrained all-M logits. Primary 2026 source Proposition 3 fails to explicitly state needed normalization, though its numerical table already adopts baseline gate. These claims are mathematically sound and the supplied verifier and independent cancellation algebra checked.

The identified omission in the 2026 Proposition 3 is genuine source-specific editorial/theorem-qualification feedback, but its exact obstruction and fix are already general published knowledge, mechanically specialized; under strict corollary coverage no independent original mathematical claim survives.
